title: Your First Session With A Persuasive Woman
description:
You’ve never experienced anything like a session with me, and we both know that’s exactly why you’re here.

Something about my voice caught you… and now you’re wondering how far a persuasive woman can take you. I’ll tell you, pet… all the way. You’ll feel your focus narrow, your body soften, and your mind follow every word I say, until you’re exactly where I want you… deep, devoted, and dripping with the need to obey.

Most people scroll right past me. You didn’t. That tells me everything I need to know about you… and by the end of this session, I’ll know everything about you too.

Press play… and let me show you how good it feels to say yes to Goddess Amethyst.

This video is for entertainment purposes only. Listen safely while seated, and never while driving or operating machinery.
author: Mistress Amethyst
